import requests

def scrape_personal_data(url):

    if response.status_code != 200:

    ]
    
    # Extract data from each element

        user_data.extend(element.find_all('div', class_=".r-Entry-User-Profile"))
    
    # Collect all personal data (e.g., names, locations, dates)
    personal_data = {
        'name': user_data[0].text.strip(),
        'location': user_data[1].text.strip(),
        'date': user_data[2].text.strip(),
        'time': user_data[3].text.strip()
    }
